Private Advisor Group Has Decreased Its Stake in Consolidated Edison (ED) as Valuation Declined; Intrust Bank Na Has Lowered Its At&T (T) Holding by $316,122; Share Price Declined
May 14, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers
Intrust Bank Na decreased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 7.3% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Intrust Bank Na sold 8,319 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 105,703 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.11M, down from 114,022 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Intrust Bank Na who had been investing in At&T Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $198.29B market cap company. It closed at $32.29 lastly. It is down 15.88% since May 14, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.43% the S&P500.
Private Advisor Group Llc decreased its stake in Consolidated Edison Inc (ED) by 30.07% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Private Advisor Group Llc sold 12,021 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.41% with the market. The institutional investor held 27,959 shares of the power generation company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.25M, down from 39,980 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Private Advisor Group Llc who had been investing in Consolidated Edison Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $23.77B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.42% or $0.32 during the last trading session, reaching $76.51. About 845,031 shares traded. Consolidated Edison, Inc. (NYSE:ED) has declined 1.18% since May 14, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 12.73% the S&P500.
Intrust Bank Na, which manages about $335.67 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Ishares Tr (IEFA) by 132,274 shares to 144,716 shares, valued at $9.56 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing.
